title: The Painting Speaks
description: A dimly lit desk holds an old CRT television displaying a haunted hallway with the text 'IF THE PAINTING SPEAKS, DO NOT FOLLOW ALONE'. An open drawer reveals a large flashlight, a red 'LOFT' key fob, a set of keys, and a handwritten note repeating the same warning. A police officer stands partially visible in the background beside a worn leather chair and a glowing desk lamp.
prompt: A tense horror scene in a dimly lit office, an old wooden desk with an open drawer containing a large black flashlight, red LOFT keychain, keys, and a handwritten note saying 'If the painting speaks, do not follow alone'. A vintage CRT television on the desk shows a creepy empty hallway with peeling paint and the same warning text on screen. A police officer stands in the shadows to the left, warm light from a brass desk lamp, smoky atmosphere, worn leather chair, cinematic lighting, moody and unsettling.
